component-metadata.description:
Create an X-Y plot using either a paired column design or a series of Y (X) columns plotted against a single X (Y) variable.
It is possible to select multiple data representations: points, lines or smooth trend lines (with or without confidence interval).

Columns can be either grouped based on experimental design or plotted as is. If experimental design is to be used, columns will be grouped based on this design and aggregated into a single column using one of the selected functions. If columns are to be plotted as is, it is necessary to remove prefices or suffices from the column names so that the new column names match. If this is not possible, an appropriate experimental design with a unique name for each column can be used.

in-ports.port: Input table containing columns to be selected for visualization
